qa_pairs.question: What type of transmission is shown in this assembly drawing?
qa_pairs.answer: This is an assembly drawing of the Getrag 260 five speed overdrive manual transmission.

qa_pairs.question: What does callout number 1 identify in this transmission diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout number 1 identifies the first gear.

qa_pairs.question: Which gear is represented by callout number 5?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout number 5 represents the fifth gear.

qa_pairs.question: What are the two shafts labeled in this transmission cross-section?
qa_pairs.answer: The two shafts labeled are the input shaft (callout 6) and the output shaft (callout 7).

qa_pairs.question: Where is the layshaft located in this transmission assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: The layshaft is located at callout number 8 and runs parallel to the main input and output shafts in the lower portion of the transmission case.

qa_pairs.question: What gear position is identified by callout number 4?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout number 4 identifies the fourth gear position.

qa_pairs.question: How many forward gears does this Getrag transmission have?
qa_pairs.answer: This Getrag 260 transmission has five forward gears, as indicated in the title and by the gear callouts 1 through 5.

qa_pairs.question: What does callout number 6 in the lower left area represent?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout number 6 in the lower left area represents reverse gear.
